name_in_paper: High-dimensional parameter flow cytometric analysis of NK cell subsets
flow cytometry assay.readouts: cell-surface and intracellular marker expression used to identify and phenotype NK cell subsets

evidence.section: Flow cytometry analysis and cell sorting
evidence.quote: For flow cytometric analysis, cells were stained in 96-well U-bottom plates in the dark using antibody panels (see Key Resources Table ). Flow cytometry data were acquired on a BD LSRII and analyzed using FCS express 6 ( De Novo Software) and custom Python scripts.

name_in_paper: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
In vitro cytokine stimulation and functi.sample_type: NK cells (CD45 + CD56 + CD3 − ) sorted from freshly processed tissue sites

evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: NK cells (CD45 + CD56 + CD3 − ) sorted from freshly processed tissue sites (see above) were cultured in 96-well u-bottom plates in RPMI-1640 medium containing fetal bovine serum (10%) with or without 10ng/ml IL-12 (PeproTech, cat# 200–12), 100ng/ml IL-15 (PeproTech, cat# 200–15) and 100ng/ml IL-18 (MBL International Corp.

measuring degranulation by NK cells.sample_type: sorted, overnight rested NK cells co-cultured with K562 cells
measuring degranulation by NK cells.readouts: CD107a expression as a marker of NK cell degranulation

evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: For measuring degranulation by NK cells, 30,000–50,000 sorted, overnight rested NK cells were incubated with K562 cells (ATCC: CCL-243; provided by Emily Mace, Columbia University) at a 2:1 effector to target (NK: K562) ratio in a 96-well tissue culture plate at 37°C at 5% CO 2 for 4 hours.

name_in_paper: Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell subsets
Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell.platform: SMART-Seq® ultra-low input RNA kit (Takara bio); HiSeq2500 system (Illumina)
Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell.sample_type: sorted CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + NK cells

evidence.section: Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell subsets
evidence.quote: RNA was isolated from sorted CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + NK cells using the RNA Easy kit (QIAGEN cat # 74004) and library preparation was done using the SMART-Seq® ultra-low input RNA kit (Takara bio). Samples were sequenced at Genewiz (South Plainfield, NJ) using a HiSeq2500 system (Illumina).
